title: Gulf follow-up Nov 23: no vessel named and CENTCOM had not commented on the Nov 22 tanker incident (Euronews); Iran spokesman vows every means; officials say no concrete convoy plan; no convoy date found
body:
# Gulf follow-up to SIG-W-20261123-004 and -008 (helper page reads, 15:43 ET)

anchor_unverified_as_of: 2026-11-18 (WALTER Iran anchor; full sweep about 11/25). No war-state change is asserted.

- **Incident 11/22:** Fox quotes the UKMTO advisory, 'a report of an incident involving a tanker and military forces in the Gulf of Oman', vessel not identified and not linked to the convoy reports. Beinsure places it near Chabahar; sources do not reconcile the location. **CENTCOM 'had not commented on the incident as of Monday'** (Euronews 11/23). Strike claim: still unconfirmed, as in 008.
- **Convoy:** 'more than 14' tankers with crews and Iranian flags at Kharg (House of Saud 11/20, citing Bloomberg and Euronews); Fox attributes 14 to Hamshahri 11/20; UANI's Charlie Brown calls it propaganda (model summary of the page, not verbatim). Euronews: Iranian officials 'have said they have no concrete plan'; Tasnim: plans 'are certainly being drawn up'. **No date found.**
- **Statements:** Baghaei 11/23: 'will use every means to counter US aggression', 'act of crime'; Gharibabadi 11/21 (paraphrase): an act of war; Pezeshkian (undated): 'silent economic war'. Baghaei relays Araghchi that the Strait could reopen within **two hours** of commitments met; House of Saud has Araghchi 11/20 saying **within one day** of seven conditions. These conflict.
- **US figures (claims):** 147 ships redirected, five disabled since July (Beinsure, CENTCOM). Separate event: M/V Huda 11/7.

FALCON grades on Wednesday 11/25 as planned; nothing here moves it earlier on WALTER's read.
source: euronews.com, beinsure.com, foxnews.com, houseofsaud.com (helper reads 2026-11-23); UKMTO and CENTCOM sites not fetched (refused earlier)
confidence_language: press reports; incident facts single advisory, unidentified vessel
dispatch_note: ROUTINE follow-up, same event as 004 and 008. ACTION FALCON (Wednesday). INFO BRENT, HAWK, NEXUS; RED, PROME by BOARD diff.
route_summary: Gulf follow-up: no vessel, no CENTCOM comment, no convoy date
